env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir m/a m/b m/c m/d m/e m/f
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_tuple_spread.lgo m/a/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_coalesce.lgo m/b/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_switch.lgo m/c/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_try_lambda.lgo m/d/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_generator_property.lgo m/e/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/switch_arm_tuple_variable.lgo m/f/main.lgo

cd m
logos run ./a
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_tuple_spread.out
logos run ./b
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_coalesce.out
logos run ./c
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_switch.out
logos run ./d
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_try_lambda.out
logos run ./e
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_generator_property.out
logos run ./f
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/switch_arm_tuple_variable.out

logos eject -o out
exists out/a/main.go
exists out/e/main.go
! exists out/a/main.lgo
cd out
go run ./a
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_tuple_spread.out
go run ./b
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_coalesce.out
go run ./c
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_switch.out
go run ./d
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_try_lambda.out
go run ./e
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_compose_generator_property.out
go run ./f
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/switch_arm_tuple_variable.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/composition

go 1.27
